footprint.symmetry: approximate fourfold symmetry around center (towers at corners, dome centered)

repeated_patterns: Use vertical stonebrick pillars on each tower edge, fill tower faces with brick and inset small glass panes in a repeating pattern.
Create layered horizontal wall bands: alternating brick, light-colored (quartz) stripe, and a thin sandstone-colored stripe; repeat 2-3 times.
raw_elements: four tall corner towers with overhanging slab caps
parapet walkway between wall and dome (low wall)
raw_hints: Construct a rectangular outer shell ~25x25 blocks, with four corner square towers extending upward ~10-12 blocks above wall line.
Use vertical stonebrick pillars on each tower edge, fill tower faces with brick and inset small glass panes in a repeating pattern.
Create layered horizontal wall bands: alternating brick, light-colored (quartz) stripe, and a thin sandstone-colored stripe; repeat 2-3 times.
Place a low white slab/band around the base one block out from wall to form the border seen in images.
Build a large hemispherical dome of dark nether_brick centered inside the rectangle; leave a ring (parapet) of flat wall between dome and outer wall.
Top each tower with an overhanging slab_stone cap (two-layered slabs) and a small glow block at center of cap for lighting.
rebuild_intent.summary: A rectangular single-story structure with a large central dome roof and four tall corner towers. Exterior walls are layered horizontal bands with brick-like and light-colored striping; each corner has a vertical stonebrick pillar leading up to square tower caps with overhanging slab trim. A low white block border runs around the base. The dome is dark red/brown and sits centered within the rectangle, leaving a ringed walkway or flat parapet between dome and outer walls.
